title: Trump Signs Executive Order Overhauling Childhood Vaccine Schedule, Citing Autism
detail: President Trump signed an executive order on August 10, 2026 laying out new 'Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations' that cut the number of federally recommended childhood immunizations from 17 to 11, call for splitting the combined MMR shot into three separate doses, and push spacing vaccines across separate medical visits. Speaking from the Oval Office alongside HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Trump linked the changes to autism, though extensive scientific research has found no such link. The order drew immediate criticism from medical organizations and Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy, who said 'Vaccines DO NOT cause autism.'

media.caption: Trump signs executive order overhauling the childhood vaccine schedule, citing unsubstantiated autism claims
